svg.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: shotsheet process (phone): five stages, one artifact each
svg.desc: analyze detects cuts and timecodes with optional ASR; describe samples three frames per shot with vision optional; rules checks duration, the opening hook and the planned caption band from one YAML; export --dry-run prints the plan and writes nothing; write draft emits one microsecond-timed segment per shot. Vision-off and no-audio paths stay visible, and rule warnings stay in the sheet.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: CORE PROCESS / EVERY STAGE LEAVES A FILE
